message.content: The color of the sea can vary widely depending on several factors such as depth, clarity, the presence of algae or plankton, weather conditions, and even the angle of sunlight. In shallow tropical waters, it often appears bright turquoise or aquamarine due to the scattering of sunlight. In deeper or more polluted waters, it may look darker blue or greenish. During sunrise or sunset, the sea can take on hues of orange, pink, or purple. Overall, the sea’s color is dynamic and influenced by both natural and environmental conditions.
